items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: So that was Harris Barrett and Joe Phillip, Trumpet, me, Fat, and I had five pieces.

ctx.x: Yeah. See they had this open up over there, bought that place, Lichtenfield Street. We advertised in the wagon and then I had to have a piano player for that night because it told me to be sure to get a piano player for that night. You know? Yeah. So that was Harris Barrett and Joe Phillip, Trumpet, me, Fat, and I had five pieces. Back to Bump, before I forget it, didn't you all play at the St. Charles Hotel? Yeah. Who was it? Was it a party or what? No. No. They had a party or what?
Back to Bump, before I forget it, didn't you all play at the St. Charles Hotel there?
